question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a silver ball, Bob has a teal ball, Claire has a grey ball, Dave has a white ball, Eve has a red ball, Fred has a yellow ball, and Gertrude has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Eve and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Eve and Fred swap balls. Then, Bob and Alice swap balls. Then, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Fred and Alice swap balls. Finally, Bob and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) silver ball
(B) teal ball
(C) grey ball
(D) white ball
(E) red ball
(F) yellow ball
(G) brown ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (silver, teal, grey, white, red, yellow, brown)
1. Dave swaps with Gertrude: (silver, teal, grey, brown, red, yellow, white)
2. Eve swaps with Gertrude: (silver, teal, grey, brown, white, yellow, red)
3. Eve swaps with Fred: (silver, teal, grey, brown, yellow, white, red)
4. Bob swaps with Alice: (teal, silver, grey, brown, yellow, white, red)
5. Fred swaps with Alice: (white, silver, grey, brown, yellow, teal, red)
6. Fred swaps with Alice: (teal, silver, grey, brown, yellow, white, red)
7. Bob swaps with Eve: (teal, yellow, grey, brown, silver, white, red)
Claire has the grey ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
